(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-transform grid cmd)
      (cond [(= cmd 0) grid]
            [(= cmd 1) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= cmd 2) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= cmd 4) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (decode cmd)
      (list (if (<= cmd 4) 0 1)
            (cond [(or (= cmd 1) (= cmd 5)) 0]
                  [(or (= cmd 2) (= cmd 6)) 1]
                  [(or (= cmd 3) (= cmd 7)) 4]
                  [else 2])))
    (let* ((a (subgrid g 2 1 4 3))
           (b (subgrid g 2 7 4 9))
           (tiles (map (lambda (pos)
                         (let* ((cmd (at g 0 pos))
                                (info (decode cmd))
                                (base (if (= (first info) 0) a b)))
                           (apply-transform base (second info))))
                       (list 1 3 7 9))))
      (vconcat (hconcat (first tiles) (second tiles))
               (hconcat (third tiles) (fourth tiles))))))
